_README: sci-toolkit external-service credentials template. Copy this file to credentials.json in the same folder and fill in your own values. credentials.json is excluded from distribution/commits via .distignore/.gitignore — never write real keys directly into this example file. Each script checks environment variables first, then falls back to credentials.json. Leave a service blank if you don't use it.

mail._note: A school/work organization mailbox and a personal mailbox (Gmail, etc.) have different IMAP/SMTP server settings. Check your organization's IT documentation for the work settings. For Gmail, issue an App Password and put it in `password` (not your login password).

github._note: GitHub Personal Access Token (fine-grained recommended, minimal scopes). Never write it directly into this file — set it as the environment variable SCITK_GITHUB_TOKEN instead.

google._note: For Google Calendar / Sheets, point to the OAuth client or service-account JSON path. Keep the actual file outside the distribution (e.g. your home directory) and specify only the path here.
